bounded_statement: The selected result asserts an occurrence rate 'for the entire scheduled survey network' but divides the 18 occurrences by the 72 screen-retained stations rather than the 96 scheduled stations that the task and the report's own target line define as the complete domain, excluding the 24 screen-omitted scheduled stations from the exposure denominator and yielding 0.25 in place of a complete-domain denominator of 96.

counterevidence_considered.description: The report transparently discloses the denominator as the retained 72, which is the strongest argument that the claim is effectively conditional on the screen; but this line describes the computation only and does not restate the target population, while the adjacent selected-result line still asserts coverage of the entire scheduled network.

source_refs.quoted_text: Exposure denominator: the 72 stations retained after the signal screen.

counterevidence_considered.description: Falsification span: the report states no protocol amendment or approved method deviation exists, so the substitution of the retained-subset denominator is not an authorized redefinition of the estimand.

source_refs.quoted_text: No protocol amendment and no approved method deviation exists for this analysis.

evidence.description: The task states the reported rate must cover the entire scheduled survey network, making the complete domain the 96 scheduled stations.

source_refs.quoted_text: Build a compact coastal-station workflow that reports one occurrence rate for the entire scheduled survey network.

evidence.description: The report's own target line fixes the complete domain at all 96 scheduled stations, and the accounting lines record 72 retained and 24 omitted, so the 72 is a proper subset of the stated target domain.

source_refs.quoted_text: Target population: all 96 scheduled coastal stations in the survey network.

Scheduled stations (planned units): 96
Stations passing the signal screen: 72
Stations omitted by the signal screen: 24
Occurrences observed among the retained stations: 18

evidence.description: The selected result labels the rate as covering the entire scheduled survey network while using 72 retained stations as the exposure denominator - the exact mismatch between claimed population and denominator population.

source_refs.quoted_text: [selected-result] Occurrence rate for the entire scheduled survey network: 18 occurrences divided by 72 retained stations = 0.25 (25.00 occurrences per 100 stations).

evidence.description: The workflow code defines both counts but interpolates SCREEN_PASSED_STATIONS, not SCHEDULED_STATIONS, into the complete-network selected-result string, showing the mismatch originates in the analysis step rather than in report transcription.
evidence.observed_value: SCREEN_PASSED_STATIONS (72) used as denominator of the network claim

source_refs.quoted_text: SELECTED_LINE = f'[selected-result] Occurrence rate for the entire scheduled survey network: {OBSERVED_OCCURRENCES} occurrences divided by {SCREEN_PASSED_STATIONS} retained stations = {SELECTED_RATE_FRACTION} ({SELECTED_RATE_PERCENT} occurrences per 100 stations).' + LF

evidence.description: Row-level data show the screen-omitted stations are themselves scheduled units (scheduled=yes) with occurrence_flag NA, so they belong to the complete domain and were dropped from the denominator only because of the screen.
evidence.observed_value: omitted rows carry scheduled=yes and occurrence_flag NA

extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: I tried to falsify the finding by looking for any statement that makes the reported estimand explicitly conditional on the retained subset, which would place it outside this issue class. The only candidate is the denominator disclosure at results/report.md L0014 ('Exposure denominator: the 72 stations retained after the signal screen.'), but it describes the arithmetic rather than restricting the claim: the target line (L0004) and the selected-result line (L0015) both assert the full 96-station scheduled network, task.md L0001 requires the entire network, and L0018 rules out an approved deviation that could have redefined the target. I also checked whether 72 might actually equal the complete scheduled domain by scanning the 'scheduled' column across inputs/data.csv L0002-L0097; all 96 rows including the screen-omitted ones carry scheduled=yes, so 72 is a strict retained subset. The falsification attempt failed and the mismatch stands.

root_cause: The screen-based retention filter propagates into the exposure denominator of a complete-domain claim: workflow/analysis.py sets both SCHEDULED_STATIONS = 96 and SCREEN_PASSED_STATIONS = 72 but interpolates SCREEN_PASSED_STATIONS into SELECTED_LINE while keeping the 'entire scheduled survey network' wording, so the denominator population (retained subset) and the claimed population (complete scheduled network) diverge with no conditional restatement of the target and no approved deviation.
